acceptance: A generic command, not zmux-specific, prints active projects one path per line, in zoxide's frecency order. A project is a directory holding .git, .jj or .project, and never $HOME. Linked worktrees, ~/.config/emacs/elpa and /workspace are left out. ~/flakes is included. Absent directories are skipped. Silent and exit 0 with no zoxide database. It lives where the ~/flakes agent judges right, since other tools are expected to use it.
notes: Offered to the ~/flakes agent with tk-flakes-wire, on the operator's say. The exclusions were seen in zoxide on Sleipnir, 2026-11-06. 2026-11-06: operator decided .jj counts as a project marker, matching zp. 2026-11-06: operator placed it in ~/.config/zsh, so it is a zsh function in functions.zsh, tested by tests/active-projects.zsh there, uncommitted in the $HOME repo. On the real database: 50 of 192 directories; ~/flakes in, and no /workspace, elpa, worktree or $HOME row. Being a function, only zsh can call it, which narrows the acceptance's other tools.
title: List active projects from zoxide
